_description: Output of nwdes state: a read-only projection of where features stand, built from each handoff, its open role drafts and its closed run records. features is always a list: the one feature named by --feature, or every feature of the configured feature directory, most recently modified first (empty when there is none). A stage nwdes cannot determine is null, never a guess; null differs from pending, which claims the stage has not started. skipped marks a stage that does not apply, such as the oracle of a prose-only slice. Slices appear in handoff order.

features.modified: ISO-8601 UTC instant of the last handoff.json change|null
